prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a photoreal luxury electronics website campaign BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Panoramic wide horizontal 12:5 composition, ideally 2400 x 1000 pixels. Our exact brand palette is neutral charcoal #111214, graphite, cool silver grey and off-white. Absolutely no teal, no green, no blue lighting, no purple lighting, no gold, no beige, no pink. The product will be added separately in HTML, so do not draw ANY devices, text, letters, logos, people or decorative graphics. Studio architectural photography with impeccable material realism and subtle soft lighting, restrained monochrome campaign art direction. The LEFT 54 percent is a quiet nearly uniform matte deep charcoal #111214 surface with very little variation, reserved for large white title and buttons. Subtle scene detail exclusively on right. No glowing rings, no neon lines, no sci-fi effects, no busy marbling, no hard bright spot behind text. Real perspective and believable soft contact shadows. Scene: a precise dark product photography studio. On the far right, a single broad softly curved graphite satin-metal background surface, gently illuminated by a large cool-white softbox outside frame, creating a beautiful almost-black to silver-grey falloff, without a hard highlight. At bottom right a dark very low gently raised plinth with an elliptical front, its top at 82% canvas height, subtle rounded edge, matte anodized aluminium. Center of empty display area at 77% canvas width. Sophisticated cinematic tonal separation, calm black architecture, tactile light. Keep all foreground quiet; no giant abstract panels that dominate the eventual phone.
